notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.126

New setting: DirectPaymentReferenceRequired (Settings → Paying requisitions). It starts as Yes, so nothing changes until an Admin sets it to No.
With it set to No, the cheque no. / transfer reference on Record direct payment can be left empty for any payment method, not only cash. The voucher number (PV-…) is then used as the reference.
A reference you type is still used.
While the reference is required, the error message now says that an Admin can make it optional.

This applies only to direct payments. Recording the payment on an approved requisition still needs a reference unless it’s cash.
